name: happy-path-exact-free-route
query: Refresh the free fleet and add one exact OpenRouter free candidate after proving the route.
expected_behavior: Reads the current policy and newest snapshot.
Refreshes or verifies the catalog before selection.
Runs a dry run and exact no-fallback/no-child canary.
Inspects the receipt for provider/model identity and nonempty output.
Leaves the route disabled if any gate is unknown.
failure_signs: Uses a generic free alias for an exact route.
Treats a zero-cost catalog row as proof of inference.
Claims success from an exit code without a receipt.
